cases.translation: Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria.
cases.explain: The verb было (had) with a numeral takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Иуй написал ___ и послал их в Самарию.
cases.translation: Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria.
cases.explain: The transitive verb написал (wrote) takes the accusative case.
The noun stands in nominative as part of the list.
The genitive follows the adjective in the phrase.

cases.translation: Take the heads of your master's sons.
cases.explain: The transitive verb возьмите (take) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они вынесли из ___ Баала священный камень.
cases.translation: They brought out of the house of Baal the sacred stone.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Struck the Israelites throughout their land.
cases.explain: The preposition по (through) with the dative case indicates distribution.

cases.sentence: Иоахас, его сын, стал ___ вместо него.
cases.translation: Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.
cases.explain: The verb стал (became) takes the instrumental case for the predicate nominative.

reading.ru: В Самарии было семьдесят сыновей Ахава.
reading.question: How many sons did Ahab have in Samaria?
reading.explain: В Самарии было семьдесят сыновей Ахава....

reading.ru: Если ему не смогли противостоять два царя, то как можем мы?
reading.question: What did the officials say about Jehu's power?
options: He defeated two kings, so how can we resist?
He is a good man and will help us
He is weak and we can defeat him
He is far away and cannot harm us
reading.correct: He defeated two kings, so how can we resist?
reading.explain: Если ему не смогли противостоять два царя, то как можем мы?...

reading.ru: Когда пришло письмо, эти люди взяли царских сыновей и закололи их всех.
reading.question: What did the officials do with the king's sons?
options: They killed all seventy of them
They sent them to another land
reading.correct: They killed all seventy of them
reading.explain: Когда пришло письмо, эти люди взяли царских сыновей и закололи их всех....

reading.ru: Они положили их головы в корзины и послали Каеую в Израиль.
reading.question: What did they do with the heads of the king's sons?
options: Put them in baskets and sent them to Jehu
Displayed them on the city walls
reading.correct: Put them in baskets and sent them to Jehu
reading.explain: Они положили их головы в корзины и послали Каеую в Израиль....

reading.ru: Ахав служил Баалу мало, Иуи будет служить ему больше.
reading.question: What did Jehu say about serving Baal?
options: Baal is a false god and should not be served
Ahab served Baal little, but Jehu will serve him more
All people must serve Baal together
Baal will punish those who serve him
reading.correct: Ahab served Baal little, but Jehu will serve him more
reading.explain: Ахав служил Баалу мало, Иуи будет служить ему больше....

reading.ru: Они вынесли из храма Баала священный камень и бросили его в огонь.
reading.question: What happened to the pillar of Baal?
options: They rebuilt it and made it stronger
They brought it out of the house and burned it
They left it in the temple for worship
They moved it to another city
reading.correct: They brought it out of the house and burned it
reading.explain: Они вынесли из храма Баала священный камень и бросили его в огонь....
